create_ToyDataset: create a ToyDataset that generates 256 binary vectors and their bit-count sums as labels
build_ToyAgent: build a ToyAgent neural network with a single linear layer mapping 8 inputs to 1 output
build_ToyGame: build a ToyGame that wraps a ToyAgent with MSELoss and returns loss and empty Interaction
test_toy_counting_gradient: test training a ToyAgent over 10000 epochs to learn bit counting via gradient descent
run_trainer: run a core.Trainer with a ToyGame, optimizer, and ToyDataset to train for a specified number of epochs
